title: Apple Music playback-failed banner appears at once and names the failing track
acceptance: When an Apple Music playback error fires on desktop Safari, the playback-failed banner appears at once; it no longer waits up to 2 s for the FairPlay probe, whose result goes only to the console.
If the adapter is re-prepared for another track while a deferred failure report is pending, the banner names the track that failed, or the stale report is dropped; it never names the next track.
Component or adapter tests cover both cases with mock MusicKit.
nextAction: From the #668 final review (items 1-2); both behaviors are already on main, not introduced by #668. The deferred reportPlaybackFailed in apps/web/src/lib/playback/apple-music-adapter.ts checks only !this.destroyed. Playback code is owner-gated. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Final review of #668 on b70f529, items 1-2: onPlaybackError waits for the desktop-Safari FairPlay probe (up to 2 s) before the banner although the probe word now goes only to the console; the deferred reportPlaybackFailed checks only !this.destroyed, so a re-prepare while the probe is pending can name the next track.
